name: ship-feature
description: Ship one spec task: plan, implement and verify (up to 3 passes), parallel reviews, aggregate, fix blocking items, re-verify and tick the task in tasks.md.

inputs.task: Spec task ID as <spec>/<task number>, e.g. web-ui/23

steps.prompt:
Plan spec task {{task}} in the repo /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life.

1. Find the task: the spec folder is /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/specs/<spec>/ and the task is the numbered line in its tasks.md. If the spec or task does not exist, or the ID matches more than one line, call send_message with severity warning naming what you found and end your turn; continue when the answer arrives.
2. Read that spec's requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md, every file in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/steering/, and /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/docs/architecture/contracts.md.
3. Write the plan to /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/plan.md with: the exact task line; every requirement ID the task satisfies (the ones it names plus any it depends on); the tests to add or change, each with its file path and the requirement ID it names; the files to change; any ADR the work needs; and the output of `git -C /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life status --porcelain` as the baseline, so later steps can tell this task's changes from changes that were already there.
4. Write /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json with exactly {"complete": false} so an old result cannot end the next loop.

Final message: the plan path, the spec name, the task line and the requirement IDs.

Implement spec task {{task}} in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life following the plan at {{artifacts.plan}}.

On the first pass, implement the plan, including the tests it lists; each test names its requirement ID. On later passes, read /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json and fix every failing check it records, then continue any part of the plan that is not done.

Rules (from .kiro/steering/tech.md and product.md): do not commit, push or rewrite history; do not run a formatter over files; never open, print or copy .env* files other than .env.example; never run next build, pnpm build or pnpm -F @ninth/web build, because the dev server may be running; never hand-edit data/ lexicon JSON; user-facing words follow the banned claims in .kiro/steering/product.md and the word list in .kiro/steering/trademarks.md. Do not tick the task in tasks.md; a later step does that.

Final message: the files you changed or created and what each change does.

Verify spec task {{task}} in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life. Do not change product code or tests in this step; the implement step fixes failures on the next pass.

1. Check the dev server: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/`. If it does not answer 200, call send_message with severity warning saying the dev server at http://localhost:3000 is not reachable and asking me to start it (from the repo root: `pnpm dev`), then end your turn. When I answer, check again before going on. Never start the server or run a build yourself.
2. Run each command on its own and record its exit code:
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life: `pnpm -r typecheck`
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run`
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/packages/web: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/responsive.mjs`
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/packages/web: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs`
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/packages/web: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/keyboard.mjs`
   - from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/packages/web: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/switch.mjs`
3. Write the working-tree diff for the reviewers: `git -C /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life diff HEAD > /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/changes.diff`, and list untracked files with `git -C /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life ls-files --others --exclude-standard`.
4. Write /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json as {"complete": <bool>, "task": "{{task}}", "checks": [{"command": "...", "cwd": "...", "exitCode": 0, "passed": true, "summary": "..."}], "failures": ["<check and the failing test or error, with file:line where known>"], "changedFiles": ["..."], "untrackedFiles": ["..."], "diff": "/Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/changes.diff"}. Set complete to true only when all six commands exit 0; otherwise false.

Convey the result only by writing that status.json. When you finish, always call send_message with severity success, whatever the result (error would end the loop). Final message: each command with pass or fail, and the failures.

branches.prompt:
Audit the Ninth Life app at http://localhost:3000/app for spec task {{task}}. Focus on the screens and components this task changed: read /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json (changedFiles, untrackedFiles) and the plan at {{artifacts.plan}}. Write your report under /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/docs/a11y/ as your instructions say.

Final message: the report path, then every finding with its severity (blocker, serious, moderate, minor), WCAG criterion or design rule, where, and the smallest fix. Say which checks you could not run.

Review the uncommitted changes for spec task {{task}} in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life. The diff against HEAD is at /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/changes.diff; new files are listed under untrackedFiles in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json, so read them directly. The plan with the requirement IDs is at {{artifacts.plan}}; its baseline git status shows changes that were there before this task, which are out of scope. status.json also records the checks that were run and their results: read it and do not claim to have run anything.

Final message: your review in your usual format (verdict line, Blocking, Non-blocking).

Review the uncommitted working-tree changes against HEAD in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life for spec task {{task}}. The diff is at /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/changes.diff and new files are listed under untrackedFiles in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json. The plan with the requirement IDs is at {{artifacts.plan}}; changes in its baseline git status are out of scope. status.json records the checks that were run and their results; read it and do not re-run the suites.

Write the review document to /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/semantic-review.md. Final message: the verdict and every finding, each marked blocking or non-blocking, with file:line.

steps.prompt:
Finish spec task {{task}} in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life. The plan is at {{artifacts.plan}} and the merged review is at {{artifacts.review}}.

1. Fix every item in the review's blocking list. Leave non-blocking items alone. If a blocking item cannot be fixed, or the fix would need a product decision, call send_message with severity warning naming the item and the choices, and end your turn.
2. Re-verify. Check the dev server with `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/`; if it does not answer 200, call send_message with severity warning asking me to start it (`pnpm dev` from the repo root) and end your turn, then check again when I answer. Run each command on its own: from the repo root `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run`; from /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/packages/web `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/responsive.mjs`, `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs`, `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/keyboard.mjs` and `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/switch.mjs`. Rewrite /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/workflow-output/status.json in the same shape as before ({"complete", "task", "checks", "failures", "changedFiles", "untrackedFiles", "diff"}), with complete true only when all six pass.
3. Only when all six pass and no blocking item is left: tick the task in /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.kiro/specs/<spec>/tasks.md by changing its `- [ ]` to `- [x]`, and tick its sub-tasks that this work completed. Change nothing else in tasks.md. If a check still fails, do not tick; call send_message with severity warning listing the failures and end your turn.

Rules: do not commit, push or rewrite history; do not run a formatter; never open .env* files other than .env.example; never run next build or pnpm build; user-facing words follow .kiro/steering/product.md and .kiro/steering/trademarks.md.

Final message: each blocking item and how it was fixed, the six commands with pass or fail, and whether the task line was ticked.
